description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
The Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade four times.
Resolve all Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
